---主界面

---@type UI.RuaUI
self = self

local clip = Asset.Load("Audio/Music/Home", "m_sys_void_intro")
local loop_clip = Asset.Load("Audio/Music/Home", "m_sys_void_loop")

--- 视差 / Parallax.
--- move1 是远景(背景横梁竖柱), 反向小幅漂移; move2 是近景(全部按钮面板), 同向大幅移动
--- move1 is the far plane - the background beams and struts - and drifts
--- slightly against the pointer. move2 is the near plane: the menu tiles the
--- player aims at, plus the clock, the currency row and the news panel. The
--- two moving opposite ways is what sells the depth.
--- The top-left icons and the whole player plate stay still on purpose, so the
--- movement has fixed points to read against.
--- Which widgets sit under each is set by Arknights/Home/Apply Parallax Groups.
--- 近景横向幅度受右边距限制 / The near group's horizontal throw is capped by the
--- layout, not by taste: DepotTile sits about 34 units from the right edge, so
--- anything past that pushes it off screen at full deflection. The depth comes
--- from the two planes moving opposite ways - 32 out and 28 back is 60 units of
--- relative travel, far more than the old version ever managed.
local MOVE1_X = -28
local MOVE1_Y = 16
local MOVE2_X = 32
local MOVE2_Y = -26

--- 近景铺满屏幕, 倾斜要小 / The near group spans most of the screen, so its tilt
--- stays small: a few degrees there already swings the outermost tiles a long way.
local MOVE2_TILT_X = 2.5
local MOVE2_TILT_Y = -2.5

--- 指针停一秒后归位 / Settle back to centre once the pointer has been still for a
--- second, so a screen nobody is touching stops holding a tilt. On a phone that
--- is the moment a finger lifts, where there is no pointer to follow at all.
local IDLE_SECONDS = 1
local FOLLOW_SPEED = 6

--- 移动多少才算动过(平方像素) / How far the pointer must travel to count as moving,
--- squared, so a mouse jittering by a pixel still counts as still.
local MOVED_THRESHOLD = 4

local target = Vector2.zero
local current = Vector2.zero

local move1Base
local move2Base
local lastX = -99999
local lastY = -99999
local idle = 0

---@type Data.Player.PlayerData
local data;

function init()
    --- 记住静止位置 / The offsets below are relative to wherever the prefab rests
    --- these two, so read that once rather than assuming it is zero.
    move1Base = move1.localPosition
    move2Base = move2.localPosition
end

function update()---刷新时间 - 跟随鼠标
    time.text = DateTime.Now:ToString("yyyy/MM/dd/ HH:mm")

    local moved = false

    if screenHasMouse() then
        local pointer = Input.mousePosition
        local dx = pointer.x - lastX
        local dy = pointer.y - lastY

        if dx * dx + dy * dy > MOVED_THRESHOLD then
            lastX = pointer.x
            lastY = pointer.y

            --- 按屏幕分辨率归一化, 不是画布 / Normalise against the screen, not the
            --- canvas. The two only agree at the reference resolution; anywhere
            --- else the pointer never reached the ends of the range, which is
            --- most of why this effect used to be so hard to notice.
            target = Vector2(pointer.x / Screen.width * 2 - 1, pointer.y / Screen.height * 2 - 1)
            moved = true
        end
    end

    if moved then
        idle = 0
    else
        idle = idle + Time.deltaTime
        if idle >= IDLE_SECONDS then
            target = Vector2.zero
        end
    end

    current = Vector2.Lerp(current, target, FOLLOW_SPEED * Time.deltaTime)

    local position = move1.localPosition
    position.x = move1Base.x + current.x * MOVE1_X
    position.y = move1Base.y + current.y * MOVE1_Y
    move1.localPosition = position

    position = move2.localPosition
    position.x = move2Base.x + current.x * MOVE2_X
    position.y = move2Base.y + current.y * MOVE2_Y
    move2.localPosition = position
    move2.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(current.y * MOVE2_TILT_X, current.x * MOVE2_TILT_Y, 0)
end

function show()
    self:BaseShow()
    SoundManager:PlayMusic(clip, false, function ()
        SoundManager:PlayMusic(loop_clip, true);
    end)
    self.canvasGroup.alpha = 0
    self:FadeIn(0.5)

    data = PlayerManager:Get()
end

function hide(destroy)
    self:FadeOut(0.5, destroy)
end

function updateView()
    playerName.text = data:GetName()
    playerLevel.text = tostring(data:GetLevel() + 1)
    expPercentage.fillAmount = data:GetExp() / data:GetMaxExp()
    reason.text = tostring(data:GetReason())
    maxReason.text = tostring(data:GetMaxReason())
    sourceStone.text = "0"
    syntheticJade.text = "0"
    dragonCoin.text = "0"

    sourceStone.text = tostring(data:GetItemAmount(0));
    syntheticJade.text = tostring(data:GetItemAmount(1));
    dragonCoin.text = tostring(data:GetItemAmount(2));
    item = data:GetItemStack(1)
end

function screenHasMouse()
    local vector3 = Input.mousePosition
    return vector3.x <= Screen.width and vector3.x > 0 and vector3.y <= Screen.height and vector3.y > 0
end
